BiblicalUsage: A trial is the word for a testing, a tried stone — and it appears once, in the cornerstone promise. In Isaiah 28:16 the Lord says, behold, I lay in Zion for a foundation a stone, a tried stone, a precious corner stone, a sure foundation: he that believeth shall not make haste. One word, for the stone that has been tested and holds.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe the tried stone is Christ: tested, precious, sure — and the one who believes on him shall not make haste.
